waves.advisorWarning: Zalpa: Dark sails off the western shoals! Three landing skiffs have hit the beach!
Zalpa: More Shardana raiders advancing up the dunes! Protect the foundry and our donkey caravans!
Burna-Khabir: The final assault fleet has landed! Drive the sea raiders back into the Aegean waves!

primary.description: Erect a Cyclopean Watchtower to monitor coastal and naval approaches.
Stockpile at least 200 units of Tin to supply the Wanax's bronze armory.
Withstand and repel all 3 Sea Peoples landing waves.

secondary.description: Do not lose the Bronze Foundry during enemy coastal incursions.

narrative.briefing: Year 1182 BC. The Aegean coasts burn. From the waters of the Great Green emerge ships with bird-head prows and crews crowned with horned helmets. At Kadesh-on-Sea, our people must rally: place cyclopean foundation slabs, extract precious tin from the sand veins, and repel the initial landings of the Sea Peoples.

dialogues.speaker: burna_khabir
dialogues.message: My Wanax, clay tablets from the great kings have ceased to arrive. The priests read the entrails: the earth shakes and the sea spits fire and bronze. We must prepare.

dialogues.speaker: tarkhunta
dialogues.message: Noble Lord, our tin supplies run dangerously low. If we do not secure the remaining cassiterite veins, we shall soon be fighting with flint spears!
